title: Shared testing for shopping list practicality tweaks
description: Add and run the targeted automated coverage for aisle auto-detection behavior, AddItemSheet manual-override behavior, and ShoppingListDetailView structure/layout regressions introduced by this feature set.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests cover exact match, alias match, quantity-prefix stripping, last-word fallback, no-match, and empty-input behavior for aisle auto-detection.
Tests verify AddItemSheet does not override a manually chosen aisle after subsequent typing and that auto-detection state transitions behave as expected.
View-level tests verify the drag handle is absent and compact-mode changes the expected detail-view layout characteristics.
Executed test commands and any residual coverage gaps are recorded.
